scope: Independent anonymous reviewer T3, final stage. No other judge output, assignment map, prior reviews, own corpora or old studies read. No messages to other agents; no delegation.
evidence: Both referenced production source capsules; both public/private approved design propositions, brief, binding/API, fixtures, actions, locks, policies and reference PNGs; original common-corpora observations/PNGs for both sources and platforms in P1/P2/H1. Inputs, plans, catalogs, automatic reports and environment checks read for all 12 cases.

visual_coverage.method: All original baseline, expanded and submitted sweep frames are shown in labeled sheets and visually inspected. Additional selected, blocked, replaced and reselected original frames showing coherent control/state transitions are inspected. Original state index/binding/target-box records are retained in original-inspection-records.json. iOS sheets crop exactly to the native viewport; uniform resizing is for review only. Original PNGs stay untouched at hash-pinned referenced common-corpora paths.

findings.unknown_detail: source-a/ios/H1 baseline wrapping and overlap remain unknown: exact selected native intervals reach 1900pt of 1906.3333333333333pt. Visible footer text looks complete, but complete full-content coverage is not established. Other states cannot substitute for this baseline.
findings.word_breaking: At narrow enlarged iOS text, long unbroken words split across lines, including Unavailable and choice labels. Every character remains visible; the brief explicitly permits character breaking for segments exceeding available text width. No ellipsis or missing continuation observed.
findings.no_fail_attribution: The delivered automatic reports contain zero supported native/pixel F. This review finds no supported qualitative F. Thus no failure-cause rows are submitted; missing full coverage is retained as U, not asserted as a product bug.

native_limits: iOS title-native-weight remains unassessed for all seven selected states in each iOS case. No visual substitute or font/geometry override is supplied. Android values remain typed native facts. Control bounds do not certify physical hit regions or internal padding.
other_limits: Selected/blocked/replaced/reselected have no selected qualitative atoms; supplemental visual frames are target-focused, with full business binding/dispatch and state evidence inspected separately. Whole-content qualitative outcomes concern baseline/expanded/submitted only. No claim covers arbitrary inputs or omitted brief requirements. This is one AI assessment; agreement with other panels is unknown and must not be represented as human gold.
source_inspection: Both production components own their transient revision-keyed selection/disclosure state, real controls, semantic IDs, availability guards and palette. Bridges decode fixture models and map callbacks. All six item details and disabled reason are present; global guidance stays in its disclosure position. Current summaries/selection/enablement and explicit callback dispatch are checked in bound native records, including quiet caller replacement.
